title: The 72-Second Signal From Space
description: In 1977, a radio telescope detected a powerful narrowband signal from space. It became known as the Wow! signal, and its source has never been confirmed.

scenes.narration: In 1977, a radio telescope detected something extraordinary.

scenes.narration: A powerful signal appeared and lasted just seventy-two seconds.

scenes.narration: An astronomer circled the data and wrote one word: Wow!

scenes.narration: The signal came from the direction of the Sagittarius constellation.

scenes.narration: It never repeated, and its source remains unknown.
